title: List the DHCP scopes
description: Show the IPv4 scopes of a DHCP server with their range, lease duration and state.

parameters.name: dhcpServer
parameters.label: DHCP server
parameters.description: DHCP server to query (localhost when run on the server)

examples.description: Show every setting of one scope
Find the scopes that are turned off
Show the DHCP servers authorized in Active Directory

notes: Requires the DhcpServer module (RSAT DHCP tools) and membership of DHCP Users or DHCP Administrators.
